targets.rawSql:
select 'document_intake' as queue, count(*) as depth from pgmq.q_document_intake
union all
select 'correspondence_dispatch' as queue, count(*) as depth from pgmq.q_correspondence_dispatch

panels.title: pgmq archive rate (messages archived per minute)

targets.rawSql:
select $__timeGroup(archived_at, '1m') as time, 'document_intake' as metric, count(*) as archived
from pgmq.a_document_intake
where $__timeFilter(archived_at)
group by 1
union all
select $__timeGroup(archived_at, '1m') as time, 'correspondence_dispatch' as metric, count(*) as archived
from pgmq.a_correspondence_dispatch
where $__timeFilter(archived_at)
group by 1
order by 1
